texts.li: [lowtech] Riders in the colours of {ENEMY} have been asking at every village and crossroads for a deserter. Today they found the colony, and {A_nameDef} went pale at the sound of {A_possessive} own name. They want {A_objective} back, to answer for it. They'll take {COUNT} silver in {A_possessive} place, or {A_objective} by force.

[!lowtech] A message from {ENEMY} comes over the comms, cold and short: they know {A_nameDef} is here. A deserter belongs to the unit until the unit says otherwise. Hand {A_objective} over, buy out {A_possessive} service for {COUNT} silver, or they'll come and take {A_objective}.

li.label: {A_nameDef} is one of us
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} says nothing, but checks {A_possessive} weapon twice. {ENEMY} will be here within hours.

li.label: {ENEMY} want their deserter
li.text: {ENEMY} have come for {A_nameDef}, who ran from them to us. The colony said no.

li.label: Buy out {A_possessive} service ({COUNT} silver)
li.outcome: {ENEMY} take the silver and strike {A_nameDef}'s name from their rolls. {A_nameDef} is free, properly free, for the first time in years.

li.label: Hand {A_nameDef} back
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} walks out to them without a word. Nobody in the colony looks at anyone else for the rest of the day.

texts.li: [grown] A young traveller of {FACTION} has come asking for {A_nameDef} by name. It takes a moment to recognise {X_objective}: {X_nameDef}, the lost child the colony once walked home, all grown up. {X_nameDef} has brought a gift, and a question: is there room here for someone who never forgot this place?
[young] {X_nameDef}, the lost child the colony once walked home, is back: a little taller, with a gift from {X_possessive} family of {FACTION} and a great many questions for {A_nameDef}.

li.label: Ask {X_objective} to stay
li.outcome: {X_nameDef} stays. {A_nameDef} pretends not to be moved, and fools nobody.

li.label: Thank {X_objective} and wish {X_objective} well
li.outcome: {X_nameDef} stays for supper, tells everyone about home, and leaves in the morning with a full pack. {FACTION} speak well of the colony.

texts.li: [won] {X_nameDef} of {FACTION}, who lost to the colony at {SKILL}, is back, and has very clearly been practising. {X_nameDef} wants a rematch against {A_nameDef}. Same rules as before: nobody gets hurt, and the colony can put silver on it.

[lost] {X_nameDef} of {FACTION}, who beat the colony at {SKILL} last time, has come back to defend the title against {A_nameDef}. {X_nameDef} is all smiles. The colony can put silver on it, if it fancies its chances this time.

li.label: Accept: {COUNT} silver on {A_nameDef}
li.outcome: The rematch is on. Half the colony has already picked a side.

li.label: Accept, for honour only
li.outcome: The rematch is on, for bragging rights. Which, this time, everyone agrees, matter a great deal.

li.label: Decline politely
li.outcome: {X_nameDef} looks disappointed, and moves on. The question of who's really better will have to wait.

texts.li: Hunters swear they've seen it: {BEAST}, the young of {DEAD}, the great beast the colony brought down. Nearly as big as its parent was and every bit as stubborn, it's roaming the colony's land now. It'll move on in a few days, unless someone makes a second legend of it.

[lowtech] The old hunters always said {DEAD} had young somewhere out there. They were right. {BEAST} has come down to the colony's land, scarred already and growing into its parent's size. It'll move on in a few days. {A_nameDef} has heard, and has gone very quiet.

[lowtech] A pedlar arrives with a bundle and a message: the pilgrims of {FACTION} the colony once fed made it to the end of their road, and they haven't forgotten. They've sent what they could spare, with their blessings.
[!lowtech] A drop pod arrives with a short note from the pilgrims of {FACTION} the colony once fed: they made it, and they haven't forgotten. Inside is what they could spare.
